scientific_integrity: Analytic proof with supplemental standalone geometric and exact-arithmetic checks; standard arc and Bernoulli formulas acknowledged; literature priority limited to inspected sources.
scientific_limitations: Valid for exact uniform one-time phase sampling and fixed two-species circular, contiguous, uniform-activity flowering arcs only. The same richness law is not a statement about longitudinal time series or species-resolved records. Sign of temporal covariance does not establish a biotic interaction; no empirical calibration or independent audit.
title: A sharp covariance-maximizing flowering-duration split invisible to one-time richness
